text: Lumen Bank savings accounts pay 3.1% annual interest, credited monthly.
Lumen Bank debit cards can be frozen instantly from the Cards tab in the mobile app.
International transfers from Lumen Bank take 1 to 3 business days and cost a flat 4 USD fee.
Lumen Bank customer support is available by chat 24/7 and by phone from 8am to 8pm on weekdays.
To open a Lumen Bank account you need a government ID and proof of address issued within the last 3 months.
Overdrafts at Lumen Bank are capped at 500 USD and cost 1.5% per month on the overdrawn amount.
